name: gridsight-ai
description: GridSight AI: grid operations intelligence platform for ERCOT-style markets

scripts.build: npm run build -w services && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w insights && npm run build -w sdk/typescript
scripts.test: npm test -w services && npm test -w insights
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w insights && npm run deploy -w infra -- -c env=dev --all --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w insights && npm run deploy -w infra -- -c env=prod --all
